description:
We are looking for someone who enjoys building software, experimenting with new technology, and solving real business problems. The ideal candidate is curious, hands-on, and comfortable using AI as part of the development process. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be interested in learning how AI can be integrated into applications, workflows, and business processes.
  
 What You Will Do
 Develop AI-powered and web-based applications across the full stack
 Build AI agents, workflow automations, and other intelligent solutions
 Use AI-enabled development tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot to accelerate software development
 Integrate AI capabilities using APIs, LLMs, and agent frameworks
 Work with business teams to understand problems and translate them into practical technology solutions
 Prototype, test, and iterate quickly on real-world business use cases
 Support application deployment, troubleshooting, documentation, and ongoing enhancements
  

 Skills and Abilities
 Working knowledge of Python and JavaScript
 Basic understanding of software development principles, APIs, databases, and application architecture
 Familiarity with web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Node.js
 Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and generative AI technologies
 Interest in AI-enabled software development, automation, and emerging technologies
 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
 Ability to learn new technologies quickly
 Ability to manage time and priorities across multiple assignments
 Good written and verbal communication skills
  
 Education
 Pursuing or recently completed a BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
 
 Special Factors 
 In office 5 days per week
 EHS Responsibilities 
 Communicates, promotes and personally demonstrates Safety/Health (including PQP Principles) as #1 priority
 Participation in risk assessment audits as applicable
 Understand PQ Principles (PQP) and how they are implemented in the site organization, rules and procedures
 Completes HSE training requirements identified for the job in a timely manner
 
 PQ is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.
